en: ...Why won't you surrender yourselves{SAUT}to my salvation?

Happiness isn't something you leave in{SAUT}someone else's hands. You have to seek{SAUT}it out and attain it yourself.{PAGE}During that search, you support the{SAUT}people you meet, and vice versa,{SAUT}to find happiness together.
When humans interact with one{SAUT}another, each person takes a toll{SAUT}upon the other's heart.{PAGE}Even if you drive me away, there will be{SAUT}no end to such strife.

That might be true―the answer we've{SAUT}reached may not always be the right{SAUT}one.{PAGE}I'm sure there'll be times where we{SAUT}unintentionally hurt others, or end up{SAUT}getting hurt...{PAGE}But even then, I want my life to be one{SAUT}where I'm content with the conclusion{SAUT}I reach.
No matter when or where, a brutal{SAUT}storm brews within humans' hearts.{PAGE}Yet, you say that you have the resolve to{SAUT}stand your ground, on your own feet?
We absolutely have that resolve.{OPTION}Don't underestimate us humans.
I'm not going to be dependent on you.{SAUT}I'll seize my happiness on my own!
You have to seize happiness on{SAUT}your own... Yeah... That's right.
Could I... really do that too?
If I can go back, then... I want to try{SAUT}again without giving up.
That's right... It's too early for me{SAUT}to give up so easily.
I'm leaving here too. I won't let what{SAUT}people think ever bother me again!
...It looks like we got through to{SAUT}everyone else, too.
So, you all choose this path despite{SAUT}the pain it brings... What fools.
